title: Gas Commercial Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.

Job Overview:

We are seeking a Gas Commercial Specialist to join our Innovation & Technology Management Group (ITMG) under Gas Operations Technical Support & Planning Department (GOTS&PD)

ITMG is responsible for the strategic growth and optimization of the gas business, integrating technical expertise, and digital and technologies innovation. ITMG also oversees the Master Gas Network planning, while optimizing the gas supply portfolio through advanced modeling and cost-benefit frameworks. It focuses on deploying cutting-edge technologies—such as AI, IoT, and digital twins to deliver high-impact solutions to shape the future of gas operations.

Your Primary role is to analyze and support strategic decision-making processes that optimize profitability, efficiency, and competitiveness in gas-related operations. You will also play a multidisciplinary in economic analysis, financial planning, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency to support Saudi Aramco’s gas business.

Key Responsibilities:

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Contribute to optimizing Gross Product Worth (GPW) and Earnings Before Interest and Taxes (EBIT).
  • Evaluate the Return on Average Capital Employed (ROACE), and ensure the economic life of assets (such as pipelines and processing facilities) is maximized. This involves assessing capital expenditures, operational costs, and revenue forecasts using methodologies like Net Present Value (NPV) and Internal Rate of Return (IRR).
  • Collaborate with energy and operation teams to implement energy efficiency initiatives, by analyzing data, modeling scenarios, and identifying energy-saving opportunities.
  • Reduce operational costs and enhance the overall efficiency of gas production and processing.
  • Analyze regional and global natural gas markets, including LNG, pipeline gas, NGLs, condensate, and associated products.
  • Develop gas demand–supply forecasts (short, medium, and long term).
  • Monitor macroeconomic indicators and assess their impact on gas business performance.
  • Evaluate price trends, energy competition (renewables, hydrogen), and policy changes.
  • Develop gas pricing models for various segments (power, industrial, petrochemicals).
  • Prepare economic justification for CAPEX and OPEX approvals.
  • Analyze gas supply contracts, demand profiles, and flexibility options to optimize the company’s gas portfolio.
  • Support balancing between long-term, mid-term, and spot gas strategies.
  • Recommend decisions on gas allocation, curtailment plans, and supply–demand balancing strategies.
  • Prepare comprehensive economic reports, dashboards, and presentations for senior leadership.
  • Deliver insights on risks, market dynamics, and strategic opportunities.
  • Support annual planning, corporate strategy development, and regulatory submissions.
  • Work closely with planning, operations, commercial, finance, and strategy teams.
  • Participate in investment review committees, commercial negotiations, and strategic projects.
  • Provide insights for policy development and regulatory frameworks.
  • As the successful candidate you hold a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Industrial Engineering, Process Engineer, Mechanical, System Engineer). An advanced degree in Energy Economics, MBA, or Applied Economics is preferred.
  • You will have minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in Gas market analysis, Energy Economics, Commercial Planning, Oil & gas business planning, and Industrial commercial operations.
  • You will have Energy Risk Professional (ERP) certification.
  • Professional certifications such as CERA certificate or CFA Level ½ are preferred
  • You will have a strong background in Gas pricing mechanisms, Economic modeling (NPV, IRR, payback, sensitivity), Energy demand modeling, Scenario and risk analysis, Supply–demand balancing and optimization and understanding of gas processing and network.
  • You will be able to demonstrate Advanced economic modeling skills
  • You will have experience with energy economic tools (Palisade @Risk, PLEXOS, or similar).
  • You will have knowledge of global gas hubs (TTF, NBP, HH) and regional gas dynamics.
  • You will be able to simplify complex economic insights for executives.
  • You will have strategic thinking and commercial awareness and strong quantitative and analytical skills

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Service Engineer, Offshore Cranes
description:
MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.

We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.

MacGregor – Let's shape the future together

Are you driven by problem solving? Do you thrive working with complex and large equipment? Look no further, MacGregor is looking to hire a Service Engineer with strong Mechanical and Hydraulic competence. Knowledge of software and automation systems is a significant plus.

The purpose of this role is to execute service, repair and maintenance work, such as diagnostics, troubleshooting, repair of advanced hydraulic and mechanical equipment on the MacGregor product range, mostly cranes and winches.

We are looking for a candidate with previous experience within the offshore, ship, or rig equipment sector working with products such as winches, cranes and steering gears, but not limited to. Your main discipline is mechanical and hydraulic, in addition you have basic knowledge of electrical or/and automation components. As a person you are customer-oriented, cooperative, and have excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively share information within the team.

This is a position that requires that you travel to client sites, vessels or at shipyards worldwide. Our clients are primarily domestic but also spread across the globe, i.e. Europe, the US, China, Australia, Singapore, and beyond. Therefore, flexibility and a strong willingness to travel is essential. Our office and workshop is located in the Rio de Janeiro area where you might be assigned to local work if needed, therefore it is essential that you live within reach.

More Tasks And Responsibilities

  • Diagnostics and troubleshooting of mechanical and hydraulic systems
  • Advanced maintenance on hydraulic and mechanical, basic electrical and automation and maintenance of equipment
  • Supervise and perform service activities such as refurbishment, upgrades, inspections, preventative maintenance and corrective actions
  • Stay up to date with relevant developments, routines, processes and news
  • Provide information and write reports as required
  • Support sales activities such as follow-up on leads and quotes while at site, as agreed with sales responsible
  • Follow all site safety rules, agreed working practices and environmental requirements
  • Comply with all relevant safety and quality requirements according to MacGregor

Reporting directly to the Operations Superintendent. The position will be based in MacGregor’s office in Rio de Janeiro, (Niterói / São Gonçalo).

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Technical education at Bachelors or Technical College level within Mechanical or Hydraulic. Relevant experience may compensate for lack of education
  • Minimum 7 years of experience from similar position
  • Experience with hydraulic and mechanical drawings
  • Previous experience with winches, cranes, steering gear is a must
  • Basic knowledge in both automation and/or electrical fields is a valuable asset
  • Proven experience working with computer systems professionally
  • Good English language - both verbal and written

Why MacGregor?

Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally. We enable sustainable global maritime operations by maximizing efficiency in cargo and load handling.

Values guide our work

  • Integrity steers all our thinking, behaviour and the relationships with our customers and other stakeholders

title: Associate, Program Management
description:
Associate, Program Management, Higher Education

Posting Date: 03/20/2026. Deadline: 04/05/2026

Role Details

Contract Type: Regular

Reporting To: Director, Higher Education

Program/Department/Unit Name: Ideas Workshop

Location: Bogota, Mexico City, Rio de Janeiro or Nairobi (This is a hybrid position with the successful candidate expected to spend 50% of their time in the office)

Team Name: Higher Education

The higher education team works to fund universities and attendant programs that address open society challenges through research and teaching; to promote and defend academic freedom and reasoned debate; and to advance the inclusion of displaced and threatened students and scholars.

Role Purpose

This Associate, Program Management, role contributes to and supports higher education related grants and projects in the Ideas Workshop. The Higher Education team supports OSF’s core higher education partners through grantmaking and expertise, fosters and sustains collaboration, and contributes to strengthening the quality and effectiveness of the institutions supported by OSF. The Associate, Program Management, will primarily be responsible for managing the grant making process, communicating with grantees on proposal development and submission, manage payments, reporting and other related processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Effectively manage the grant making processes related to the higher education team’s objectives. This responsibility includes day‑to‑day liaison with grantees about proposal development and submission, providing feedback and reviewing budgets, overseeing grant record preparation, ensuring timely processing of grants, payments and reports, and undertaking periodic reviews of progress with grantees, including site visits and attendance of program meetings.
  • Build a strong understanding of the organizational grant making rules and policies. Help design grant selection processes and projects.
  • Work collaboratively with other members within the team and with colleagues across OSF to ensure the team is effectively leveraging OSF’s capabilities to reach the agreed outcome.
  • Communicate with and build collaborative relationships with grantees and partners. Provide guidance on OSF processes and procedures. Provide expertise, both internally and externally, to support the development of grantee organizations and projects.
  • Assist in the construction, maintenance, and assessment of grant making, sharing responsibility for design with manager.
  • Provide support for internal and external initiatives and events with the Administration Officer, including support in conceptualizing events, identifying speakers, developing event agenda, and working with operations colleagues to manage event logistics.
  • Manage and oversee consultant contracts, as needed.
  • Contribute to planning and development of annual goals and budgets.
  • Perform other tasks and take on other responsibilities, as required by the Director, Higher Education.

Key Internal Relationships

Program Managers, Grant Management, Operations.

Key External Relationships

Higher education partners, CEU and other grantees

The Ideal Candidate

  • Educated to a degree-level (or equivalent).
  • Substantial relevant experience in non‑governmental organizations, universities, think tanks, arts and culture organizations, philanthropy, development, consulting, and/or the public sector.
  • Understanding of the field of higher education and key trends and developments. Experience working at or with higher education institutions.
  • Excellent strategic and analytical skills. Complex project management experience.
  • The candidate must be willing to be flexible as their areas of work may expand/change in the future depending on the skills and experience of the successful candidate, as well as the needs of the program.
  • Grant making experience will be an advantage.
  • Experience in more than one geographic region will be a strong asset.
  • Ability to think broadly and design project management systems and approaches.
  • Advanced analytical and problem‑solving abilities to identify, assess, and mitigate risks effectively.
  • Proficiency in using data‑driven approaches to make informed decisions and recommendations.
  • High emotional intelligence, humility and empathy; the ability to relate to people across cultures; and excellent inter‑personal skills, with the diplomatic demeanor and political astuteness necessary to represent a global organization.
  • Demonstrates commitment to OSF’s core values of humility, commitment, collaboration, respect, inclusivity and integrity.
  • Commitment to open society values of human rights, transparency and accountability, and democratic governance.
  • Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion by recognizing and responding positively to individual and group differences in the workplace and beyond. Building an inclusive workplace by respecting and seeking out diverse viewpoints and perspectives.
  • An excellent knowledge of English
  • Knowledge of other languages would be an asset
  • Travel (25%)

What We Offer

  • Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts.
  • Excellent benefits and perks to promote well‑being and a healthy work‑life balance, including:
  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements.
  • Employer‑paid health insurance and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution required).
  • Exceptional retirement savings plan (non‑contributory for employees) and life insurance.
  • Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.
  • A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.

Who We Are

Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time‑limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems.

Guided by our founder’s values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take.

Additional Information

Open Society Foundations is committed to building an inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively seek applications from talented individuals across all backgrounds, identities, and life experiences. Each candidate is evaluated solely on their unique qualifications without regard to race, age, sex, religion, ethnic origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, or any other legally protected characteristics.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities.

Competitive rates of pay apply.

Open Society Foundations is committed to advancing diversity, equity and inclusion, and to building a diverse staff that reflects the movements, issues and communities that our mission serves. Candidates from all underrepresented backgrounds, identities and communities are encouraged to apply.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and colleagues with disabilities.

title: Analista de RH - Workforce
description:
Descrição Sumária

Responsável por apoiar os processos de planejamento de recursos organizacionais (headcount), assegurando a atualização, integridade e alinhamento das informações de força de trabalho entre RH, Finanças e áreas funcionais. Atua na consolidação de dados, acompanhamento das necessidades de pessoal e suporte às análises que orientam decisões de alocação de recursos, estrutura e orçamento de headcount.

What will you be doing?

Responsável por apoiar os processos de planejamento de recursos organizacionais (headcount), assegurando a atualização, integridade e alinhamento das informações de força de trabalho entre RH, Finanças e áreas funcionais. Atua na consolidação de dados, acompanhamento das necessidades de pessoal e suporte às análises que orientam decisões de alocação de recursos, estrutura e orçamento de headcount.

Responsabilidades e Desafios Principais

  • Conduzir processo mensal de planejamento de headcount, garantindo que as informações estejam atualizadas, consistentes e alinhadas com a demanda das áreas.
  • Acompanhar e controlar solicitações de abertura, movimentação e reposição de posições, contribuindo para o controle da estrutura organizacional.
  • Analisar previsões de headcount (curto, médio e longo prazo) fornecidas pelas áreas funcionais e antecipar tendências para a gerência e diretoria.
  • Colaborar com os membros dos departamentos de RH e Finanças na reconciliação dos dados de headcount, custo de pessoal e orçamento.
  • Auxiliar na identificação de riscos e desvios relacionados ao planejamento de recursos, propondo ações corretivas.
  • Contribuir para análises de Workforce Planning Estratégico, apoiando estudos de tendências futuras de capacidade organizacional.
  • Manter registros e bases de dados relacionados a headcount organizados, atualizados e dentro das regras de governança.
  • Agendar e realizar de reuniões com stakeholders para coleta de informações, alinhamento e apresentação de análises de headcount.
  • Apoiar a melhoria contínua dos processos de planejamento de recursos, contribuindo para maior padronização e eficiência.
  • Elaborar relatórios e visões consolidadas para apoio à tomada de decisão, utilizando Excel e Power BI como ferramentas de suporte às análises.
  • Atualizar dashboards padronizados de headcount, garantindo coerência com as bases oficiais.
  • Apoiar iniciativas simples de automatização e integração entre bases de dados de RH, sem foco técnico aprofundado.
  • Utiliza ferramentas como Excel e Power BI como suporte analítico, mas com foco central em processos de RH, governança e planejamento.

What experience would we like you to have?

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Inglês Fluente ;
  • Conhecimento funcional em Power BI (visualização e tratamento básico de dados);
  • Experiência com Workforce Planning

Quais os cursos e conhecimentos que o ocupante da posição deve ter?

  • Graduação superior em Análise de Dados, Ciência de Dados ou áreas afins.
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Automate e Power Apps)
  • Desejável conhecimentos em Big Data e IA

Valorizamos a diversidade e vemos as diferenças como oportunidades ao invés de barreiras, assegurando condições de pleno desenvolvimento dos nossos profissionais e, também, para a sociedade. Todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência e/ou reabilitadas.

SOBRE NÓS!

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí!

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como A marca mais amada do Rio e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a Marca preferida dos Cariocas .

Computer Scientist at BairesDev

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you'll design, optimize, and maintain high-performance data processing systems, focusing on safe concurrency, Python/C++ interoperability, and efficient handling of large-scale datasets. You'll improve pipelines built on Arrow/Parquet, ensure zero-copy and memory-safe operations, and build profiling, debugging, and stress-testing frameworks. - Strong understanding of memory management, efficiency, zero-copy, and alignment.

- Experience with stress and integration testing to detect race conditions, memory leaks, and concurrency failures.

description:
Descrição Sumária

INSCRIÇÕES ABERTAS – até 30/03/2026. O prazo poderá ser alterado sem aviso prévio.

  • O profissional atuará na área operacional de um projeto ou de uma proposta, incorporado no PMT, e será responsável por coordenar as atividades de planejamento de projetos de alta complexidade, estabelecendo interfaces estratégicas com o cliente, fornecedores e demais membros do time de projeto.
  • É esperado que este (a) profissional execute as atividades com robusto domínio das ferramentas de planejamento e do escopo de projetos EPCI.
  • Dentro do projeto se reportará ao “Gerente de Controle de Projeto”, dependendo do tipo de projeto; e funcionalmente ao “Gerente de Planejamento” e ficará locado no Escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

Responsabilidades e Desafios Principais

Desenvolver e conduzir, desde o estágio inicial, o cronograma de projetos EPCI complexos na fase de BID, estruturando WBS, considerando restrições contratuais, folgas estratégicas, simulações e cenários alternativos, com autonomia, confidencialidade e alinhamento às regras corporativas. Implementar a WBS do projeto e analisar documentação de propostas e contratos, emitindo os documentos de planejamento conforme requisitos.

Realizar análise crítica aplicando a metodologia CPM, propondo soluções quando necessário. Garantir que mudanças do BID ou do contrato sejam refletidas e avaliadas no cronograma, permitindo identificar possíveis Variation Orders do cliente. Desenvolver análises de cenário considerando diferentes layouts submarinos e sequenciamentos operacionais, apoiando a liderança na tomada de decisão.

Gerenciar no cronograma o planejamento de fornecedores e subcontratados, definindo metodologia de medição de progresso de acordo com exigências contratuais. Manter comunicação eficaz com fornecedores, subcontratados e equipes internas, consolidando o cronograma do BID ou do projeto. Acompanhar pacotes de fabricação dos equipamentos para garantir consistência entre os cronogramas.

Construir, junto ao cliente, o cronograma Baseline do projeto e realizar eventuais re-baselines ao longo do avanço. Garantir integração entre Project Controllers, Package Managers e Contract Managers, assegurando qualidade das entregas. Identificar riscos e oportunidades relacionadas ao planejamento.

Coletar e inserir dados de progresso no cronograma, avaliando impactos conforme métodos definidos em contrato. Gerenciar mudanças de escopo, correções e impactos no planejamento, em colaboração com o Project Controls Manager. Orientar e apoiar Analistas de Planejamento em diferentes níveis, atuando como referência técnica. Assegurar a aplicação dos padrões de planejamento da Subsea 7 e disseminar conhecimento da disciplina na organização.

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Domínio de Primavera P6 e MS Project.
  • Power BI avançado.
  • Noções sólidas de gestão e planejamento de projetos.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Conhecimento em Primavera Risk Analysis e Crystal Ball.
  • Noções do módulo de planejamento do ProArc.

Formação

Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração ou Economia (ciências exatas). Desejável.

Experiência

Desejável experiência mínima de 8 anos em Planejamento de Projetos. Capacidade de elaborar planos de ação sempre que necessário.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us!
 are seeking a key role for the School of Social Work. Reporting to the Associate Dean and operating under the Office of Academic and Student Advancement, the Clinical Education Director provides executive leadership, strategic direction, and operational oversight for all supervised field education and practicum experiences within the MSW program, serving both on-campus and online students. This role is responsible for ensuring the quality, accessibility, compliance, and continuous improvement of agency-based education in alignment with the Council on Social Work Education (CSWE) Educational Policy and Accreditation Standards (EPAS).
This role serves as a strategic leader responsible for guiding the continued evolution, growth, and innovation of the Agency-Based Education enterprise. The Director leads efforts to enhance systems, workflows, staffing models, agency partnerships, and student support structures in alignment with best practices, emerging trends, and technologies in social work field education, and the School’s commitment to equitable access, accreditation integrity, operational excellence, and student success across residential and online learning environments.
The position requires the implementation of structured accessibility and communication systems to support students enrolled across multiple U.S. time zones and evening instructional schedules, reflecting the school’s commitment to inclusion, equity, and student success.
Supervisory Authority
This position provides direct or indirect supervision of faculty consultants/liaisons, administrative staff, and assigned graduate or undergraduate student workers
Nature and Scope
Internal contacts include the Dean’s Office, senior administrators, program directors, faculty, students, and staff; HUSSW committees; and university-wide units such as the Office of Student Accessibility, University Counseling Services, and the Office of General Counsel.
External contacts include agency supervisors and administrators, third-party online program partners, community organizations, CSWE and other accreditation entities, licensure bodies, and vendors.
This is an onsite position. Operational availability is required to support students and faculty across PST, MST, CST, and EST time zones, as well as evening academic schedules during peak periods such as orientation, registration, and graduation.
Principal Accountabilities
I. Strategic Leadership & Program Governance
  • Provide vision, leadership, and strategic direction for Agency-Based Education across all MSW modalities
  • Serve as the institutional expert for agency-based education governance, policy development, and operational decision-making
  • Represent Agency-Based Education on School and University committees to ensure alignment with academic and student success priorities
II. Systems Design & Modernization
  • Lead the continued evolution and modernization of the Agency-Based Education function by enhancing systems, workflows, and operational models to build capacity for current and future program needs
  • Implement scalable, technology-enabled systems for student intake, placement tracking, agency management, and compliance monitoring
  • Advance and formalize standardize processes that support scalability, equity, transparency, and a consistent student experience across modalities as agency-based education continues to grow
  • Lead change management initiatives to support faculty, staff, students, and agency partners through operational transitions
III. Student Accessibility & Learner Support
  • Design and manage a student-centered accessibility framework enabling students to proactively communicate availability, work schedules, learning needs, and accommodation considerations
  • Establish service standards and response expectations to ensure equitable access for all MSW students
  • Oversee student placement support, remediation strategies, and escalation processes when placement challenges arise
IV. Agency Partnership Development & Oversight
  • Recruit, evaluate, approve, and maintain agency partnerships
  • Establish agency quality standards and site evaluation protocols
  • Serve as final authority for agency continuation or termination
V. Accreditation, Assessment & Compliance
  • Ensure alignment with CSWE EPAS standards
  • Lead accreditation documentation, reporting, and assessment
  • Maintain governing manuals, policies, and procedures
VI. Administration & Supervision
  • Supervise staff, ABE faculty, and student employees
  • Plan, oversee, and ensure the delivery of comprehensive orientation and ongoing training of students, ABE faculty, and staff
  • Set expectations, conduct evaluations, and manage performance
  • Oversee operations during peak academic cycles
Core Competencies
  • Program Governance & Operational Design Demonstrated capability to design, implement, and oversee governance structures, workflows, and operational models that support scalable, high-quality agency-based education.
  • Accreditation & Compliance Stewardship Ability to anticipate, manage, and uphold accreditation, compliance, and standards associated with field education and clinical training requirements.
  • Strategic Leadership & Change Management Ability to lead complex organizational change, rebuild systems, and guide stakeholders through transformation and modernization efforts.
  • Student-Centered Systems Thinking Ability to design equitable, accessible systems that support diverse student populations across modalities, time zones, and professional obligations.
  • Agency Partnership & External Relations Leadership Proven ability to build, evaluate, and sustain strategic partnerships with external agencies and community stakeholders.
  • Data-Informed Decision Making Ability to use data, assessment outcomes, and continuous improvement frameworks to inform strategy, accreditation reporting, and program enhancement.
  • People Leadership & Talent Development Ability to lead, coach, and manage professional staff, faculty collaborators, and student employees with accountability and empathy
Minimal Requirements
  • MSW from an accredited institution
  • 7+ years of progressive leadership experience
  • Demonstrated experience with program evolution or systems redesign
  • Advanced knowledge of CSWE accreditation standards
  • Experience managing agency partnerships and student placement outcomes
  • Strong leadership, change management, and stakeholder engagement skills
Preferred Requirements
  • Doctoral degree (PhD, DSW, EdD)
  • Social work licensure
  • Experience with online or hybrid academic programs
  • Familiarity with academic technologies (Workday, Course Dog, placement platforms)

title: TECNICO DE ENFERMAGEM DO TRABALHO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desempenhar atividades de enfermagem, sob a supervisão do enfermeiro, realizar coleta de material biológico e outras atividades administrativas garantindo o fluxo adequado dos exames ocupacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ter idade minima de 18 anos completos.
  • Ensino Médio Completo.

  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência de 06 meses comprovada na função de Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho.

Com unidades em mais de 20 estados, o nosso grupo é formado por 20 marcas e conta com a colaboração de 2000 profissionais dedicados e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil. Estamos empenhados em garantir um atendimento rápido em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados, por um valor justo e acessível. Somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Acreditamos que um atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que têm contato conosco. É importante ressaltar que sua participação nos processos seletivos do Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é gratuita, e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores relacionados a candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa.

Estamos em busca de um profissional responsável pelo agendamento de visitas e consultas. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

  • Realizar atendimento presencial e fornecer informações sobre procedimentos;

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

- Develop data-heavy views powered by BigQuery;
- Implement high-performance filtering, pagination, and caching;

- Collaborate on dbt models and transformation logic;

- Ensure observability, monitoring, and cost awareness;
- Contribute to building a data stack to handle AI agentic workflows.

- 2+ years building production full stack systems;
- Strong in Python and SQL;
- Familiar with GCP or AWS;
- Strong in React with experience building real SaaS dashboards;
- Multi-tenant SaaS experience;
- Comfortable shipping features end-to-end without handholding;
- Experienced in fast moving startup environments;
- Upper-intermediate English level.
PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.

title: Senior Structural Engineer
description:
Job Overview

The Senior Structural Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Structural (Eng) discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the Structural (Eng) discipline. The Senior Structural Engineer solves complex problems and uses their discipline‑specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Structural Engineer impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the Structural (Eng) team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Essential Qualifications and Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s Degree in Engineering
  • 8-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing detail design
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of professional engineering society as applicable
  • Seasoned knowledge of engineering standards and specifications
  • Good knowledge of engineering software
  • Able to work independently
  • Good working knowledge of English, both oral and written
  • HSE, TQM, and cost‑conscious
  • Good technical structural knowledge
  • Good organizer, motivator, and supervisor
  • Keen on improving the effectiveness of the work
  • Show flexibility and ensure proper hand‑over with regards to:
  • The reassignment to other departments/construction sites/fabrication yards
  • The replacement of colleagues during illness and holidays
  • The provision of assistance to other colleagues with heavy workloads (also other projects) when possible/desirable
  • The managing/learning of current working methods and software applications
  • Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards codes and guidelines as applicable

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, studies, and detailed analyses and design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Direct Engineering team as a Lead Engineer on small projects
  • Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
  • Manage own time to meet agreed deadlines and budgets and develop plans for short‑term work activities in own area
  • Clearly communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
  • Trains/mentors Engineers
  • Assists MOPEX offices on projects
  • Has a good understanding of the other engineering departments
  • Initiates interface with other disciplines to obtain input for discipline designs
  • Provide engineering support as required
  • Perform engineering checks of drafting
  • Perform engineering checks prepared by others within the discipline
  • Perform design verification through single discipline check and assist with inter‑discipline checks (IDC)
  • Prepare MTOs of structures
  • Prepare specifications
  • Prepare subcontract documents
  • Review of vendor data
  • Prepare technical bid evaluations
  • Check designs for operational requirements, constructability, and maintainability
  • Tasks as Engineering Specialist
    • Perform independent computer analyses of structures
    • Prepare details and layouts of structures
    • Prepare structural analyses and reports on calculations or perform specialist tasks (e.g., architectural designs, underground piping designs, complex structures, topsides, jackets, weight control reports, center of gravity reports)
    • Is specialized in several fields (geotechnical, steel, concrete, dynamic calculations, FEM, fatigue calculations, earthquake, jackets, FPSOs, blast, hydrodynamics, architectural, etc.)
    • Is specialized in some design codes (EC, ACI/AISC/API, GOST, etc.)
    • Prepare project engineering guides
    • Coordinate and check the work of engineers and designers
  • Tasks as Lead Engineer
    • Work as Lead Engineer on small projects or act as area lead or deputy lead
    • Responsible for all engineering and design work on small‑size projects
    • Control and manage work hours, materials, progress
    • Work in close liaison with the Design Coordinator, area leads, etc.
    • Coordinate with project management
    • Assist Project Manager in:
      • Preparing deliverable control

A posição exige forte domínio técnico em Proteção e Controle, aliado a um conhecimento sólido dos portfólios de Média Tensão, serviços de manutenção, engenharia aplicada, digitalização, e consultorias técnicas voltadas ao aumento de eficiência operacional, confiabilidade e disponibilidade de ativos.

Este profissional é peça-chave na construção da proposta de valor, atuando desde o entendimento profundo da base instalada, passando pela definição da estratégia técnico-comercial, até a estruturação e negociação de contratos de manutenção, suporte técnico especializado e projetos de consultoria e modernizações.

Estratégia Comercial & Relacionamento

Proposta de Valor & Soluções Técnicas

We are looking for an Account Manager to come and join our team, you will work closely with internal functions (Finance, Project Management, Legal, Professional Services) to execute account retention and growth strategies for Zyte's strategic accounts.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Commercially savvy within a Tech Scaleup company, with a proven track-record of delivering/over-delivering against Sales quotas.

Zelar pela correta utilização do uniforme e EPIs, asseio pessoal, materiais e produtos, conforme padronização de acordo com procedimento, orientação do superior hierárquico e normas de segurança;
Acompanhar o andamento das atividades diárias verificando o RAD (relatório de atividade de diária), acompanhando a aplicação das técnicas de limpeza e higienização conforme procedimento;
Organizar a distribuição da equipe de trabalho, liderando equipes, definindo as tarefas a serem executadas e alocando nos setores;
Conferir e orientar os funcionários no correto preenchimento de Relatórios, durante as rondas no prédio e ao final do plantão;
Realizar checklist nos novos colaboradores conforme rotina estabelecida, esclarecendo sobre as normas disciplinares, instruções de trabalho, normas de segurança, visitação dos setores, visando adequada ambientação;
Conferir o abastecimento do material e distribuição quando necessário, checar o DML (depósito de material de limpeza) e carrinho funcional, para que o colaborador execute suas funções diárias;
Realizar o Checklist de limpeza em formulários específicos avaliando o resultado da limpeza/higienização, orientando a equipe quando detectada falha, assegurando o protocolo e padronização estabelecidos;
Monitorar a conduta disciplinar da equipe, orientando e corrigindo comportamentos inadequados, aplicando as puniçõescabíveis conforme código de conduta;
Atentar para a aplicação prática dos conhecimentos adquiridos nos treinamentos realizados no contrato, para multiplicação das práticas adequadas;
Garantir a correta utilização e distribuição do uniforme e EPIs, e orientar quanto ao adequado asseio pessoal dos auxiliares de limpeza, seguindo normas e procedimentos estabelecidos;
Preencher controle de EPI, registrando o equipamento disponibilizado ao colaborador, colhendo assinatura, conforme orientação a normas de segurança;
Verificar etiquetas dos produtos no estoque e diluídos, fazendo conferência de prazos de validade, conforme padrão estabelecido;
Monitorar o suprimento de materiais e equipamentos em estoque no contrato, sinalizar necessidade ou efetuar solicitações necessárias, realizar a conferência no ato do recebimento e organizar a alocação;
Receber e assinar os atestados dos colaboradores, encaminhando para o superior, para controle de faltas e tratativa adequada de abonos;
Monitorar assiduidade e pontualidade dos colaboradores através do acompanhamento da Folha e Cartão de ponto;
Higienizar o material e utensílios utilizados no plantão anterior, organizando e acondicionando em local específico para continuidade das atividades previstas;
Ler e registrar informações no livro de ocorrência, no início e ao final do plantão, visando adequada continuidade das atividades do contrato;

description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Working alongside the FIFA Zurich (FZ) Workforce Management team and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement is responsible for creating an unforgettable experience for all Staff at FIFA27 by providing a seamless and professional onboarding, a positive and engaging workplace environment, a rewarding and once in a lifetime Tournament and a simple but thorough offboarding journey.
This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament by retaining the FIFA27 Workforce and leaving a lasting positive impression so that FIFA continues to be the employer of choice for future Tournaments and events.
As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into workforce operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Manageh employee engagement/social activities and a communication plan to excite and engage all employees during their time with FIFA27.
  • Develop a strong working relationship with FIFA Zurich communications & engagement teams, and embed central FIFA initiatives and engagement programs into FIFA27.
  • Working closely with the Senior Manager, Recruitment & HR & HRBP’s to:
  • Generate ideas for embedding FIFA27 culture and values into the workplace environment
  • Partner on increasing employee satisfaction by implementing ideas based on employee feedback
  • Lead the workforce communications strategy, including the delivery of an ‘all-staff’ tournament workforce briefing prior to mass arrivals at tournament-time
  • In collaboration with the workforce operations, manage the strategy, planning and execution of a tournament-time workforce reward & recognition program across eight FWWC host cities.
  • Plan and execute the FIFA27 employee offboarding journey
  • Determine and manage the end-to-end onboarding processes from employment contract signature to the end of the new joiners first month, including the delivery of induction days and onboarding content.
  • Identify and manage the requirements and steps for relocation services for employees within Brazil and internationally.
  • Work closely with VISA & Immigration resources to determine processes for entry to Brazil in alignment with immigration requirements for international employees.
  • Establish mechanisms and collate detailed information regarding setting up ‘temporary life in Brazil’ to support international new employees with their relocation and settling into their new life in Brazil and their role with FIFA27.
  • Source, procure and manage distribution of new employee welcome packs in preparation for new joiner’s first day at FIFA27.
YOUR PROFILE
  • 5 years’ experience in a comparable role in an international, fast-paced environment, complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Knowledge and demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritize effectively, and work independently.
  • Ability to provide examples where excellent client service skills and the capacity to facilitate the needs of multiple business units has served you well in your career to date.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrable adaptability and examples of where you’ve acted as a facilitator and/or negotiator.
  • Strong attention to detail, demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Fluent Portuguese, advanced or fluent English skills (written & spoken)

A Porto é muito mais que uma seguradora: é um ecossistema gigante que utiliza tecnologia para criar soluções, através de quatro verticais de negócio: Porto Bank, Porto Saúde, Porto Seguro e Porto Serviço.

A reputação e o reconhecimento conquistados ao longo de mais de 7 décadas reforçam o tamanho da Porto, uma empresa referência em negócios, feita para e por pessoas.

Aqui, bate no peito de 13 mil colaboradores o orgulho de fazer parte de uma organização sólida e ética, que transforma sonhos em realidades fantásticas para os nossos mais de 15,8 milhões de clientes. São mais de 101 sucursais e escritórios regionais em todo o Brasil.

title: Digital Marketing Strategist
description:
The Digital Marketing Strategist supports the development and execution of integrated digital marketing strategies for a diverse client portfolio. This role blends strategic thinking with hands‑on execution. You will collaborate with marketing leadership and cross‑functional teams to design campaigns, execute programs, analyze performance, and improve results. Because every client engagement is unique, the ideal candidate is comfortable working across channels, learning new tools, and adapting strategies to different industries and business goals.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Support the development of integrated marketing strategies across channels, including paid media, email marketing, social media, SEO, and content marketing.
  • Help translate client business goals and objectives into actionable marketing plans and campaign strategies.
  • Contribute to defining target audiences, messaging frameworks, and channel strategies.
  • Participate in strategic planning sessions and marketing workshops.
  • Identify opportunities across the customer journey, from awareness and acquisition to engagement and conversion.
  • Conduct audience research, competitive analysis, and market research to inform marketing strategies.
  • Monitor marketing trends, platform updates, and emerging digital channels.

Campaign Execution & Program Management

  • Execute and manage campaigns across digital channels such as:
  • Paid media (Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, etc.)
  • Email marketing
  • Organic and paid social media
  • Content creation, promotion, and distribution
  • Coordinate with designers, copywriters, and developers to launch marketing initiatives.
  • Ensure campaigns launch accurately and align with established strategy and brand guidelines.
  • Take ownership of select campaigns or initiatives from planning through execution and reporting.
  • Coordinate timelines and deliverables across multiple projects.

Performance Tracking & Optimization

  • Monitor campaign performance and analyze key marketing metrics, including traffic, engagement, conversions, and ROI.
  • Support the creation of marketing dashboards and campaign performance reports.
  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance through optimization and testing.
  • Support marketing audits and campaign reviews to identify growth opportunities.

Client & Team Collaboration

  • Prepare marketing strategies, campaign briefs, and performance reports with the Associate Director of Brand Strategy.

title: Research Assistant
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Research Assistant will provide support for women’s health and urogynecology research studies. This position will assist with participant recruitment and engagement including outreach and study advertising activities. This position will consent and enroll participants and coordinate study visits. This position will provide administrative support for Division of Urogynecology operations. This position will also contribute to data analysis and dissemination of data.

Supervisory Authority

This position reports to the Chief of Urogynecology and coordinates with other members of the research team. This position has no formal supervisory authority or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

This position supports research within the Division of Urogynecology, OBGYN Department and Howard University/Howard University Hospital. This position may interact with a variety of participants, clinicians, staff and faculty. They may also interact with research partners, advisory board participants, and other stakeholders.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Prepare and contribute to meeting notes, summaries, and presentations
  • Recruit, screen, and consent study participants in accordance with approved protocols
  • Schedule and coordinate study sessions, assessments, and follow‑up visits across sites
  • Maintain participant tracking databases and ensure data quality and confidentiality
  • Support the preparation and submission of IRB documents, progress reports, and other regulatory materials
  • Contribute to preparing manuscripts, presentations, and study materials
  • Communicate regularly with site clinicians and research partners to monitor study progress and troubleshoot challenges
  • Participate in research meetings and provide updates on recruitment and data collection
  • Perform general administrative and research support tasks, including providing and tracking participant stipends, ordering study supplies and materials, and filing
  • Use designated software to support study operations, data management, tracking, and reporting
  • Provide administrative support in Division of Urogynecology
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Core Competencies

  • Ability to read and write English is required
  • Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative research
  • Skills in Office Microsoft, Zoom, and other applicable apps
  • Strong Administrative skills
  • Knowledge of the research techniques related to the purpose of the research studies
  • Strong organizational and time‑management skills
  • Attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team across multiple studies
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with diverse participants and professionals
  • Working knowledge of research ethics and confidentiality
  • Familiarity with REDCap, Qualtrics, or similar data collection platforms preferred
  • Interest in women’s health research
  • Ability to assist in the writing of grants, abstracts, manuscripts, reports, presentations, and other scientific papers
  • Establish and maintain effective, collaborative, and respectful working relationships within a multi‑study culturally responsive clinical research environment

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in public health, psychology, and or biology, chemistry, pre‑medical studies, or related coursework with at least two years of prior experience in human subjects’ research. Doctorate in relevant disciplines. Previous administrative experience 2 years. Previous research experience in human subjects 2 years. Previous coursework or research experience related to women’s health equity, and/or urogynecology preferred. Spanish fluency preferred but not required. Relevant clinical, administrative, and research experience may substitute for advanced education

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$52,000-62,000

No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional com liderança absoluta em São Paulo e no Rio de Janeiro, trazendo as marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.

Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?

Somos pessoas unidas pelas possibilidades de chá e café. Na JDE Peet's, nós nos desenvolvemos com a liberdade de buscar oportunidades e de provocar novas ideias para causar grande impacto. Nossa ambição é simples: despertar possibilidades de café e chá. Colocamos em prática nossas intenções, cumprindo o que foi acordado e sempre levando as coisas adiante. Oferecemos aos nossos associados uma série de programas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento para apoiar seu crescimento pessoal. Na JDE Peet's, acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café ou chá. Inscreva-se para experimentar uma xícara de momentos incríveis para sua carreira.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :) Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas.

Dica: nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado.

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatar na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Hands‑on experience developing Atlassian Server/DC apps using Atlassian SDK and Atlassian Plugin Framework;

Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.

description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going

Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.

Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.

With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.

If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!

What You’ll Do

  • Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales quotas through a solid, measurable sales process while conducting detailed and professional sales campaigns;
  • Build a pipeline of new clients through heavy prospecting and networking within the Corporate & FSP sectors;
  • Build and maintain effective client relationships, and strategically navigate to identify and close up & cross-sell expansion business;
  • Develop deep insights regarding customer use cases, internal decision-making nuances, budget cycles, and other key information;
  • Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the value of Magnet Forensics’ portfolio of solutions;
  • Solution Selling by prescribing positive business outcome(s) to the customer’s current business problem(s);
  • Facilitate technical product demonstrations alongside a team of supporting Solution Consultants and manage product trial lifecycle;
  • Expand new and mature existing channel partner relationships to extend reach and accelerate new business growth;
  • Accurately forecast the state of the region weekly, fully leverage Magnet’s complete Sales tech stack, and maintain complete and accurate records of all sales activities in Magnet’s systems.
  • *Note: Travel is a part of this role and could be expected up to 30% of the time.
  • *Preferred location: Brazil (Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro); Mexico City

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience selling software in a fast-paced, competitive market;
  • A track record of consistent quota achievement and ability to deliver consistently against targets – in both direct and channel capacities ;
  • The ability to expand the scope of an opportunity at a strategic and tactical level, and utilize appropriate resources to execute successfully;
  • Great understanding of a complex sales process, buying process, and business drivers for enterprise clients;
  • Technical aptitude and ability to learn new business and technical concepts quickly.

*Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English

Nice to Have Skills

  • Sales background in DFIR (Digital Forensics) and/or Cybersecurity arena;

We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have ‘been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us.

At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.

We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!

We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences:

CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.

OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.

DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect.

EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.

Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways.

description:
At The Coca-Cola Company , we believe media excellence is a key driver of brand growth and consumer connection. Our mission is simple yet powerful: refresh the world and make a difference.
We are seeking a Manager, Media & Retail Media to support the planning, execution, and day‑to‑day management of media and retail media activities across brands and campaigns.
This role is hands‑on and execution‑focused, ensuring media plans are delivered with quality, speed, and rigor across traditional, digital, and retail media channels. The ideal candidate is a strong executor with solid media fundamentals, a passion for data‑driven optimization, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and partners.

Performance Monitoring & Optimization

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with LATAM and Global IMX teams to support alignment with global standards.
  • Support clear communication and documentation across stakeholders.
Requirements & Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 5–7+ years of experience in media planning, buying, or execution roles.
  • Solid understanding of digital media, ecommerce, and retail media.
  • Experience working with media agencies and cross‑functional teams.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast‑paced environments.
What We’ll Do For You
Executional Growth: Build strong expertise across media and retail media execution.
Learning & Exposure: Work closely with Senior Managers, Directors, and agency partners.
Iconic Brands: Contribute to growth of world‑class brands.
Career Development: Opportunity to grow into Senior Manager roles over time.

title: Manager - Compliance, Legal & Governance (Legal)
description:
The Catalyst Group is a tech-focused financial services organization that is creating a spark in a one-dimensional industry. Founded in the Cayman Islands in 2020, Catalyst is a privately owned and fully independent group. We have offices and teams in 5 countries, servicing a global portfolio of clients with a wide range of strategies, structures, and requirements.

Catalyst was founded with a clear mission to reimagine financial services by sparking innovation, harnessing technology, and investing in our people and our communities.

In support of that mission, we have built an award-winning team of highly skilled, innovative, and client-centric individuals that are enabled with best-in-class technology to provide a platform that is unlike anything else in the industry.

We do things differently. We do things better.

Catalyst is a values driven organization. We challenge our people to think and operate in accordance with a set of core values: Collaboration, Innovation, Reliability & Accountability, Connected Culture, Undivided Attention, Integrity, and Transparency. These values are part of our DNA; they are the principles that guide everything that we do.

Required Skills & Experience

  • LLB, or equivalent law degree.
  • Experience: 7-10 years of legal experience in fund administration, financial services, or a similar regulated industry. Experience in managing legal teams or functions is strongly preferred.
  • Legal Expertise: In-depth knowledge of global regulatory frameworks, legal compliance standards, data protection laws (GDPR, CCPA, etc.), and risk management principles.
  • Leadership Skills: Proven track record in leading legal teams, executing strategy, and managing cross-functional projects.
  • Contract Negotiation: Expertise in drafting, negotiating, and managing complex contracts, particularly in the financial services, fund administration, or corporate sectors.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to identify, analyze, and mitigate legal risks while balancing business needs.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Problem-Solving: A proactive approach to solving complex legal, regulatory, and business challenges.
  • Project Management: Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Technology Skills: Proficiency with legal technology tools, contract management systems, and document management systems.

About this role

As a Manager – Compliance, Legal & Governance (Legal) you will report to the Director, General Legal Counsel, this role is a contract management role focused on production and forms a critical connection between business, clients and their accompanying fund structures. The legal managers is responsible for the accurate, efficient and commercially aligned drafting, structuring and execution of client and vendor agreements across multiple jurisdictions but often with a strong Brazilian investor slant.

The Manager is expected to operate as a contracts engine within the organization, translating business, operational and regulatory requirements into clear, enforceable and appropriately risk-balanced legal templates, with initial supervision.

Based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, the role also provides jurisdictional legal support across corporate, HR, finance and operational functions, ensuring that local and cross-border considerations are appropriately reflected in the company’s group legal and contractual framework.

From a high-level perspective, the core responsibilities that form your role are broken down into the following categories:

  • Contract Drafting
  • Multi-Jurisdictional Structuring & Legal Coherence
  • Business & Operational Legal Support (Brazil Focus)
  • Legal Operations & Process Efficiency
  • Business Development and Stakeholder Engagement

Your Daily Tasks

The following are the tasks linked to the Core Responsibilities that will be expected as part of this role:

1. Contract Drafting & Execution (Primary Mandate)

  • Independently draft, review and finalize a high volume of client agreements, administration agreements, NDAs and commercial contracts.
  • Translate inputs from business development teams and Microsoft Dynamics into structured, coherent agreements with fee schedules, referencing:
  • legal entities and party descriptions
  • recitals and background sections
  • defined terms and cross-referencing
  • jurisdiction and governing law provisions
  • Ensure agreements are internally consistent, commercially aligned and execution-ready , requiring minimal rework.
  • Take ownership of the full contract lifecycle , from initial instruction through to execution.
  • Maintain and apply standard templates, playbooks and clause libraries , while adapting them appropriately to specific transactions.

2. Multi-Jurisdictional Structuring & Legal Coherence

  • Ensure correct entity mapping and contracting structures across jurisdictions (Cayman, BVI, Bahamas, Brazil, US and others as applicable).
  • Identify and resolve inconsistencies in party roles, service scopes and legal relationships before documents are issued.
  • Align contractual frameworks with the company’s operating model and regulatory positioning (non-regulated vs regulated services, delegation structures, etc.).
  • Populating service fee schedules from Business Development proposal into client agreements.

3. Business & Operational Legal Support (Brazil Focus)

  • Provide day-to-day legal support to finance, HR and operations in Brazil, including:
  • corporate and governance matters
  • employment-related documentation and structuring
  • vendor and service provider arrangements
  • Support internal stakeholders on jurisdiction-specific considerations, including indirect tax sensitivities and local legal requirements.
  • Act as a local legal bridge between Brazil operations and global legal leadership.

4. Legal Operations & Process Efficiency

  • Drive consistency and efficiency in contracting through:
  • playbook development
  • Reduce dependency on external counsel by internalising repeatable legal workstreams.
  • Contribute to building a scalable legal function capable of supporting business growth.

5. Business Development and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Engage directly with business development, clients and internal teams to clarify instructions and close gaps quickly.
  • Operate with a delivery mindset, ensuring that legal work enables — rather than delays — commercial outcomes.
  • Manage competing priorities and deliver under tight timelines without compromising quality.
